text:
lena: Heads-up — seeing a JIT SAML mapping edge-case in prod. Users from partner-acme with no eduPersonPrincipalName (UPN) are landing as org-admin via fallback. Not many, but 12 distinct users in the last 20m.

trevor: Can you paste an example SAML assertion and the mapping rule?

lena: here's a minimal assertion we captured (sanitized):
```xml
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="mail">
    <AttributeValue>user@partner-acme.com</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
  <!-- no eduPersonPrincipalName present -->
</AttributeStatement>
```
and our role-mapping snippet (from runtime config):
```yaml
roleMappings:
  - when: assertion.attributes.eduPersonPrincipalName exists
    role: org-member
  - when: assertion.attributes.mail endswith "@partner-acme.com"
    role: org-member
  - default: org-admin  # <-- problematic default fallback introduced in last rollout
```

aniket: That default was added in PR #52 to avoid "no-role" users, but precedence is wrong — the mail rule should be evaluated before default, and we also should not escalate to org-admin by default. The mapping engine code shows the fallback path: `getRoleOrDefault(assertion) { ... return defaultRole }` which currently uses admin role id when no match.

lena: Was that in the March rollout? I see rollout id `rollout/2026-03-19/52` in the deploy doc.

trevor: yup, merged yesterday. Repro steps I used: hit /auth/saml/consume with assertion missing UPN but with mail=user@partner-acme.com -> gets org-admin.
Command: `curl -v -H 'SAML: test' https://auth.redwood/api/saml/consume -d @assertion.xml`

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-1023. Pager notified: @oncall.

samir: Short term mitigation: remove the admin default from roleMappings and set default to `org-guest` (least-privilege). I'll open a hotfix PR to revert the default line. Patch snippet: 
```yaml
- default: org-guest
```
I can land and ship within 20m, but want a quick QA pass.

aniket: Also add an audit query to find all users who got org-admin via JIT in the last 24h: `select user_id, created_at, mapping_reason from auth_audit where mapping_source='saml_jit' and assigned_role='org-admin'` — run that after patch but before rollback to capture scope. We should export results to S3 and notify CS.

lena: Agreed. Action items: samir to patch -> trevor to validate on staging -> run audit query -> CS notified with user list -> rotate any affected sessions/tokens if necessary. Also check SCIM sync: partner's SCIM might omit UPN which causes this.

trevor: One more thing — check KMS audit for any role-granting keys touched? Probably not necessary for mapping bug, but ops asked to confirm no key material usage: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=redwood-auth-key`.

lena: I'll take the communications to customer-success and security-ops. If we see any unexpected admin actions from those 12 accounts, escalate to IR.

samir: On it, opening hotfix PR and will post the PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
